name: Slideshow Contrast Pop
description: Full-screen image slideshow where the next slide zooms in from the side with a horizontal stretch while the outgoing slide pops in contrast and saturation before fading away.
contents: Round previous and next buttons with a scroll hint label
behavior: Wheel, touch and drag gestures move to the next or previous slide, looping at the ends
Incoming slide scales up from small while its image un-stretches horizontally
Outgoing slide boosts contrast and saturation, then scales down and fades out
Navigation is locked while a transition runs
Images are preloaded and the slideshow appears once ready
editableByProps: Images, background and text colors, hint text
Timing, easing, scale, stretch, contrast and saturation of the transition
Wheel sensitivity, navigation button visibility, size and colors

needsCodeEdit.change: Change the slide direction to vertical
needsCodeEdit.where: xPercent in the fromTo call on upcomingSlide inside navigate
The ← and → characters in the two nav buttons

fixed: Fills the viewport height with full-bleed slides
Wheel, touch and pointer gestures are captured on the slideshow area
